map_reference.comparison: Rounded building footprint visually compared with the traced exterior; map contains no room-number assignment

limitations: Cardinal-sector reference, not a surveyed facade bearing or a calibrated photographic registration
The exterior is curved; individual window panes need not share one exact normal
F03 drawing-up and its historical north/south labels are not geographic north
No CAD, furniture, equipment, robot poses or motion curves are rotated; no solar/lighting simulation is implemented by this reference
